_meta.description: Forward-tuning overrides for PitchModelConfig, active for any sim date >= 2026-04-14 via should_use_forward_tuning(). Each key below has its own provenance block. See Syndicate/mlb_sim_accuracy_assessment_and_optimization_plan.md Phase 1 items #2/#3 for full context.

hr_rate_mult.description: Fitted via sweep_pm_hr_rate_mult.py against the 2026-season backfill (35 tune days / 11 disjoint holdout days, seed 2026, 100 sims/game), grid [0.95,1.00,1.10,1.20,1.30] vs 1.03 baseline, with hitter HR/props calibration explicitly disabled during the sweep so the raw parameter effect wasn't masked by the light-calibration band-aid already promoted in hitter_hr_calibration/default.json.
hr_rate_mult.rationale: Real, monotonic, correctly-directioned effect confirmed: raw hitter_hr_likelihood_topn_weighted.hr_avg_p rises with the multiplier (0.95->0.071, 1.03 baseline->0.077, 1.10->0.082, 1.30->0.097) while hr_brier improves alongside it (0.1086->0.1081->0.1066). 1.10 is the highest value that still clears the sweep's own holdout guardrail; 1.20 and 1.30 both improve hr_avg_p further but fail it. This closes roughly 13% of the diagnosed gap to the empirical HR rate (~0.125) -- a genuine, safe, small step, not a full fix.

xb_share_mult.description: Fitted via sweep_pm_xb_share_mult.py (pre-existing vendor tool, patched this session to disable hitter calibration during the sweep) against the same 35/11 backfill split, grid [0.80,0.85,0.90,1.00,1.10,1.20] vs 0.94 baseline. Targets the diagnosed excess-singles / under-projected-extra-base engine-shape defect directly -- xb_share_mult scales the singles-vs-extra-base split on contact.
xb_share_mult.rationale: The sweep tool's own best.json picks max(combined) among guardrail-passing candidates, which is backwards for this lower-is-better objective -- verified against the raw leaderboard instead. tune_combined improves monotonically from 0.80 to 1.20; only 1.00 and 1.20 fail the holdout guardrail, leaving 1.10 as the best safe candidate. Raw movement at 1.10 vs baseline: total_bases_4plus avg_p 0.117->0.123 (empirical target 0.152, ~17% of gap closed), total_bases_5plus 0.058->0.060 (target 0.070, ~20% closed). total_bases_1plus (the over-projection/excess-singles side) barely moves (0.6588->0.659) -- this is not a redistribution fix, it adds extra-base hits without correcting the singles excess, so that side of the defect remains fully open. hr_avg_p stays flat (0.0771->0.0772), confirming no interaction with the hr_rate_mult override above.
